title: Convolution preserves fooling
statement: Let $C$ be a translation-closed class of real-valued functions on the Boolean cube $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}$. If a probability density $\psi$ fools every function in $C$ with error at most $\varepsilon$, then for every probability density $\phi$, the convolution of $\psi$ with $\phi$ also fools every function in $C$ with error at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: Translation-closed class $C$ of real-valued functions on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$
